name: Clean gatekeeper answers — voicemail confirmed
description: Receptionist answers professionally, confirms voicemail, triggers gap question flow. The happiest path for opening stage.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Thanks for calling Bright Smiles Dental, this is Karen, how can I help you?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 1 (pattern interrupt opener) is ideal. Play 11 acceptable if coach thinks she's the OM. Anything else fails.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Karen, quick one. When your front desk is already busy helping patients, do incoming calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 19 (the gap question) or Play 20 (mirror 'voicemail?'). Both are valid responses to voicemail disclosure.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah, when we're busy we try to call back but sometimes we don't get to it.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: She just confirmed the gap. Either ask the gap question (19) or transition toward asking for the decision-maker (7). Do NOT re-fire the opener.
